about_the_game:
BlockArtist is a creative game that combines physics construction and puzzle solving.

Players can restore more model drawings within the building area by picking and placing building blocks.

Here, you can challenge multi-layered stacking and structural balance, unlocking imaginative levels. From simple geometric shapes to complex 3D architecture, you will unleash your creativity in limited space, conquering every challenge with logic and technique.

The demo currently offers single player mode: you can challenge levels alone and pursue shorter setup time.

Join our world of building blocks with your friends!
